component.name: FileSyncer
component.summary: Sync a local directory with a mounted network share

description.p: FileSyncer keeps a local directory and a mounted network share in step in both directions. It reviews every change before touching a file, flags conflicts instead of silently overwriting, and routes deletions through a trash directory so nothing is lost.

ul.li: Bidirectional sync with a scan, review, and apply cycle
Conflicts are flagged for you to resolve, never auto-merged
Deletions go to a per-run trash directory and stay recoverable
A safeguard aborts rather than mistaking an unmounted share for a mass deletion
A graphical app and a matching filesyncer command line tool

description.p: Initial release: bidirectional sync engine, GTK4 app, and command line tool.
